slug: 2025-12-28 Over 1.3 Million Citizens Enrolled on INRIS

facts.fact: The Ministry of Home Affairs says it is implementing end-to-end automation of birth and death notifications through the INRIS API Manager, with real-time updates to population records.

systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship
Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship

facts.fact: About 1.3 million citizens have been enrolled onto the National Registration Information System (INRIS), per the Home Affairs spokesperson.
The government is procuring smart card printers and blank cards to issue secure biometric National Registration Cards after the 2026 General Elections.
